headline: Donkey Kong now pays for every hazard you dodge
lede: The arcade's obstacle bonus always had two halves — jump over for 100, walk past for 50. The port only ever paid the jump. Now the ground game pays too, with a lower blip so the pair reads big/small like the law says.

notes.text: DONKEY KONG (§Scoring fidelity): a barrel crossing your column below the feet while grounded pays +50, exactly once per barrel — pure world-state, no dice, and the jump's 100 can never double-dip. Proven by kongcheck's new §obstacle-bonus (6 pins) plus 4 named mutants that all die, and a deterministic live rig in Chrome (paid=1, delta=50).

The idle-kick phantom is dead (#3672): parseGaps now declines struck-through README bullets, so shipped work stops scoring as weakness and re-aiming free lanes at dead ground. Five verified stale bullets were closed alongside — Frogger's tunes note, a Pong colon outlier, Asteroids' AGENTS-blessed omission, Pinball's defaulted decision, and a mis-cited issue number on Pac-Man.

Pac-Man's browser-tier evidence gap is now named honestly and on the board as its own small job (#3755: write pacmandrive) — its old note blamed a Chrome abort that no longer exists and cited the wrong issue.
Donkey Kong's honest-gaps list got honest back: the walk-past clause is CLOSED with the law, while the oil-drum flame and the timer-zero capture law stay open as the named next rungs.
